description: Defines data structures, macros, and function prototypes for managing channel sets and bandwidth sets in a wireless networking context.

methods.name: map_cs_set
methods.description: Sets a specific channel in the channel set if valid.

methods.name: map_cs_unset
methods.description: Unsets a specific channel in the channel set if valid.

methods.name: map_cs_is_set
methods.description: Checks if a specific channel is set in the channel set.

methods.name: map_cs_nr
methods.description: Returns the number of channels set in the channel set.

methods.name: map_cs_set_all
methods.description: Sets all channels in the channel set.

methods.name: map_cs_unset_all
methods.description: Unsets all channels in the channel set.

methods.name: map_cs_copy
methods.description: Copies one channel set to another.

methods.name: map_cs_or
methods.description: Performs bitwise OR on two channel sets.

methods.name: map_cs_and
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND on two channel sets.

methods.name: map_cs_and_not
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND NOT on two channel sets.

methods.name: map_cs_to_string
methods.description: Converts a channel set to a string representation.

methods.name: map_cs_from_string
methods.description: Parses a string to populate a channel set.

methods.name: map_cs_bw_to_string
methods.description: Converts bandwidth channel sets to string.
